The '''DL-56 blaster pistol''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] [[Lilla Dade]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] elite [[Katarn Commandos]] used a DL-56 during the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol]].<ref name="TSB" />
